plan_metadata.reading_focus: Fluency — read 2 pages from Dog Man with expression
plan_metadata.enrichment_theme: Animal habitats — draw and label a wolf habitat

blocks.title: Startup Routine
blocks.subject: startup
blocks.goal: Get settled, gather materials, feel ready
blocks.instructions: Take 3 slow breaths. Get your book and pencil. Look at today's plan. Tap 'ready' when you're set.

blocks.title: Reading Block
blocks.subject: reading
blocks.goal: Read 2 pages of Dog Man with expression and fluency
blocks.instructions: Open to page 14. Read pages 14 and 15 out loud. Try to read with expression — change your voice for different characters.
blocks.adaptation: If 2 pages feels like too much today, 1 page is okay. Tell your guide.
blocks.ef_transition_support: Reading is done. Great work. Take a 5-minute break before math.

blocks.title: Movement Break
blocks.subject: break
blocks.instructions: Stand up. Shake out your hands. Walk around for 2 minutes. Drink some water. Come back when the timer ends.
blocks.ef_transition_support: Ready for math when you are.

blocks.title: Math Block
blocks.subject: math
blocks.goal: Solve 3 addition with regrouping problems correctly
blocks.instructions: Today: 3 problems. One at a time. Reference strip is available. Take your time on each one.
blocks.adaptation: If 3 problems feels like too much, do 2 and flag for your guide.
blocks.ef_transition_support: Math is done. That was real work. Take a breath before enrichment.

completion.notes: Completed all 3 problems. Got 2 of 3 correct on first try. Confidence check: 3/5

blocks.title: Enrichment — Animal Habitats
blocks.subject: enrichment
blocks.goal: Draw and label a wolf habitat
blocks.instructions: Today we're thinking about where wolves live. Draw a wolf habitat (forest, mountains, or tundra — your choice). Label at least 3 things in your drawing. There's no wrong way to do this.
blocks.adaptation: Can do this digitally if preferred (drawing app).
blocks.ef_transition_support: Enrichment done. One more block — the wrap-up is short.

completion.notes: High engagement. Drew a forest habitat, labeled trees, snow, and a den.

blocks.title: Wrap-Up
blocks.subject: wrap_up
blocks.instructions: You're almost done. Answer one question: What was the best part of today's learning? Then tap 'Finish Today.'

completion.notes: Student response: 'Drawing the wolf was fun.'
